provider: Federal Reserve Board, H.15; underlying Treasury constant-maturity yields: U.S. Treasury
license: Public domain under the Board website reuse policy unless otherwise indicated; these selected U.S. government yield series carry no identified third-party restriction.
attribution: Source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (US), H.15 Selected Interest Rates; U.S. Treasury constant-maturity yields.
unit: Percent per annum, not decimal returns or bond prices
normalization: Only date and five selected government nominal yields; unchanged numeric values. Retain dates with an observed 10-year yield, exclude missing-10y/non-observation dates. No forward/backward filling. Other missing tenors remain missing for train-fitted feature imputation.
vintage_limitation: Current published historical vintage retrieved in October 2026; not an archived historical release panel. Source can revise past values. Exact historical release timestamps are not reconstructed.
timing_rule: H.15 currently posts at 16:15 ET with prior business-day rates; a full intervening observation session is reserved before the t+2 09:00 modeled decision. This is a conservative assumption rather than historical release proof.
